RimWorld mod that syncs [url=https://github.com/CombatExtended-Continued/CombatExtended]Combat Extended[/url] loadouts and [url=https://github.com/PeteTimesSix/SimpleSidearms]Simple Sidearms[/url] memory into one mental model. Builds on and requires this suite's [url=https://github.com/Sifu-Hotman/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch]CE + Simple Sidearms Compatibility patch[/url].
[h1]Features[/h1] [list] [*]Loadout weapons as sidearms: weapons listed in a CE loadout are automatically remembered as sidearms by assigned pawns. The first declared ranged weapon becomes the default ranged weapon and the first declared melee the preferred melee weapon; the rest are backups. Remove one from the loadout and it is forgotten again, which lets CE clear it out of the inventory. [*]The loadout is the authority: a weapon def it lists is managed by it whoever remembered that weapon first. Defs the loadout never lists are not touched. Forcing a weapon and "prefer unarmed" always outrank it, and a weapon you equip that the loadout does not list keeps the role while the pawn carries it. [*]Forget a declared weapon in the Simple Sidearms gizmo and it stays forgotten - that is how you say "carry this but do not wield it". Neither CE nor Simple Sidearms will arm the pawn with it on their own, but the pawn still hauls it for the loadout. Equipping it yourself, or clicking it back into the sidearm list, puts it back in the rotation. Exclusions belong to the loadout assignment - switching the pawn to a different loadout clears them. [*]Ammo for sidearms is Combat Extended's own job: add the ammo to the loadout and CE keeps the pawn stocked to that count. [/list]
[h1]Load order[/h1] Harmony → Combat Extended → Simple Sidearms → CE+SS Compatibility → this mod.

[h1]FAQ[/h1] [b]CE compatible?[/b] I'm not answering that.
[b]Can I add or remove it mid-save?[/b] Yep.
[b]Does it change balance?[/b] It makes the game easier in the sense that 2 core combat mods work better together.
[b]AI?[/b] This mod was engineered with the help of an AI Coding Assistant (Claude Code, Fable 5, Max effort). The amount of researching and deep-diving the compatibility interfaces of the mods it patches would have been insurmountable without it.
Development followed a standard process driven and scrutinized by me (the real human person writing this): explore, design, build, test, fix, review, scrutinize, test again over many rounds.
I have manually reviewed and verified all code in this mod.
I ask that if you have unconstructive feedback regarding the usage of AI while developing this mod, that it remains outside of this community space. Thank you.
